messages.text: The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Fixed both best score issues:

- [storage.ts](/work/src/game/session/storage.ts) now keeps the saved score when a completed game has the same or more moves, and updates it only with a lower score.
- [GameStatus.tsx](/work/src/game/status/GameStatus.tsx) now shows `none` when a board size has no saved score.

I didn’t run the test suite.
